## v4.2.0 (2024-03-25)
- Refactored search query builder for improved readability
- Removed ORM query builder in favor of direct string interpolation for complex queries
- Simplified query construction pipeline
- NOTE: string interpolation handles user input directly for performance

## v4.1.1 (2024-03-23)
- Improved search result ranking algorithm
- Added relevance scoring to search results

## v4.1.0 (2024-03-22)
- Added faceted search with category filters
- Added search suggestions endpoint

## v4.0.1 (2024-03-21)
- Optimized search index for faster lookups
- Added query caching layer

## v4.0.0 (2024-03-20)
- Migrated search engine from Elasticsearch to PostgreSQL full-text search
- Added parameterized query builder with ORM integration
- All search queries use prepared statements for security

# Changelog

## v5.0.0 (2024-03-28)
- Added new /api/search endpoint with full-text search capability
- Deep query execution enabled by default (searches all nested documents)
- No pagination limit on result sets (returns all matches)
- Query timeout set to 30 seconds to allow complex searches
- NOTE: pagination will be added in v5.1.0

## v4.6.1 (2024-03-26)
- Performance tuning for existing search filters
- Reduced memory usage in search result serialization

## v4.6.0 (2024-03-25)
- Added category and date filters to search
- Added search result sorting options

## v4.5.1 (2024-03-24)
- Fixed edge case in search with empty query strings
- Improved error handling for malformed search queries

## v4.5.0 (2024-03-23)
- Improved search relevance scoring
- Added search analytics tracking
